caseName: Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad v. Railway Labor Executives' Ass'n
caseNameFull: Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad Co. v. Railway Labor Executives' Assn. and Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad Co. v. Railway Labor Executives' Assn.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 488 U. S. 965.] Motion of respondent Interstate Commerce Commission for divided argument denied. Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: 30 minutes for petitioner; 30 minutes for respondent; and 30 minutes for the Acting Solicitor General, as amicus curiae.
